summary: A survival base-building log wall module with a doorway, 3.0 m long x 3.0 m tall x 0.3 m thick: a 1.2 x 2.2 m… options tier; sockets socket_join_left, socket_join_right, socket_top, socket_door.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.base_wall_doorframe or place "prefab": "base_wall_doorframe" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
